title: 12 Best Wander through a blaze of hydrangeas, roses, and sunflowers at Da Lat's 4am wholesale flower market, supplying florists across Vietnam.
description: Discover Da Lat's vibrant 4am wholesale flower market, a sensory explosion of hydrangeas, roses, and sunflowers. Find the best stalls, nearby farms, and essential tips for an unforgettable early morning experience.

places.name: Chợ Đêm Đà Lạt - Khu Chợ Hoa Sỉ (Da Lat Night Market - Wholesale Flower Section)
places.priceRange: Free entry; flowers from 50,000 VND (~$2 USD) per bundle
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A mixed bouquet of seasonal blooms, or a single rare variety you've never seen before.

places.name: Khu Chuyên Hoa Hồng (The Rose Specialist Zone)
places.priceRange: 50,000 - 200,000 VND (~$2-8 USD) per dozen, depending on variety
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bundle of 'Juliet' garden roses for their exquisite scent and shape, or vibrant 'Freedom' roses for their classic beauty.

places.name: Góc Cẩm Tú Cầu (Hydrangea Corner)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A large bouquet of blue or purple hydrangeas, a true symbol of Da Lat.

places.name: Sạp Hoa Hướng Dương & Hoa Đồng Tiền (Sunflower & Gerbera Daisy Stalls)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A mixed bundle of bright yellow sunflowers and multi-colored gerbera daisies.

places.name: Làng Hoa Vạn Thành (Van Thanh Flower Village)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh-cut bouquet directly from the farm, often cheaper than retail, or a potted plant souvenir.

places.name: Làng Hoa Hà Đông (Ha Dong Flower Village)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A beautiful potted orchid, a perfect long-lasting souvenir.

places.name: Cafe Tùng (Cafe Tung)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Cà Phê Sữa Đá (Vietnamese iced milk coffee) or Bạc Xỉu (iced coffee with more milk and less coffee).

places.name: Bánh Mì Xíu Mại Hoàng Diệu (Banh Mi Xiu Mai Hoang Dieu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bánh Mì Xíu Mại (Pork meatball soup with baguette).

places.name: Hiệu Hoa Dalat Hasfarm (Dalat Hasfarm Flower Shop)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A professionally arranged bouquet showcasing Da Lat's best roses or lilies.

places.name: Chợ Đà Lạt - Khu Chợ Rau Củ Quả Sỉ (Da Lat Market - Wholesale Vegetable & Fruit Section)
places.priceRange: Free entry; produce from 10,000 VND (~$0.4 USD) per kg
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh strawberries (Da Lat specialty), local artichokes, or a bag of dried fruit.

places.name: Hồ Xuân Hương (Xuan Huong Lake Shore)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A peaceful walk or a ride on a swan paddle boat (later in the morning).

places.name: Quán Ăn Sáng Thanh Tâm (Thanh Tam Breakfast Eatery)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Phở Bò (Beef Pho) or Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang (Nam Vang Noodle Soup).
